response_text: {"decomposition_id":"D3","label":"Unified Independent Director and Single Audit Committee Standard","object":"a single 'independent director' definition and one audit committee that satisfies FDICIA (Part 363), SOX §301, and exchange listing requirements simultaneously","consolidated_text":"A covered institution shall apply one 'independent director' definition, canonicalized across Part 363 Appendix A independence criteria, SOX §301, Appendix D independence standards, and applicable NYSE/Nasdaq listing rules, so that a director determined independent under this unified definition is independent for all such regimes. The institution shall maintain a single, properly-composed audit committee that is deemed to satisfy Part 363, SOX §301, and exchange committee requirements together, harmonizing the FDICIA regime (b:AUD-01..03, including b:AUD-02 / Part 363 Appendix A) with the SOX regime. Consistent with s:BCG-14, for institutions over $3 billion the audit committee should include members with banking or financial-management expertise. Consistent with s:GOV-12, the audit committee shall meet directly with the Chief Audit Executive, support the internal-audit budget and staffing, and review the status of remediation.","operands_cited":["AppD-independence","NYSE/Nasdaq","Part363+SOX301+exchange committee requirements","SOX-301","SOX-regime","b:AUD-01..03(FDICIA regime)","b:AUD-02(Part363 AppA)","one properly-composed audit committee","s:BCG-14: For institutions over $3 billion, the audit committee should include members with banking or financial-management expert","s:GOV-12: Audit committee meets directly with the CAE; supports internal-audit budget and staffing; reviews status of remediation "],"notes":"Consolidation canonicalizes the independence definition across the four regimes and deems a single audit committee sufficient for all, per the DEEM_SATISFIED and CANONICALIZE_DEFINITION operations.
